summary: News Corp filed an 8-K to provide copies of disclosures to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding its existing $1 billion share repurchase program. The filing details daily transaction disclosures required under ASX rules and includes forward-looking statements about the intent to repurchase Class A and Class B common stock from time to time. No new buyback authorization or change to the repurchase plan is announced. This is a routine reporting of ongoing buyback activity under a previously disclosed program, not a special situation event.
